in_marathi.name: Joshik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Joshik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Joshik is the name of a deity associated with joy, happiness, and prosperity. He is believed to bestow these blessings upon his devotees.
